purpose: Pre-registered confirmation plan: v6-v11 (and the v10/v12 reviewer-response extensions) all selected methods, arms, comparisons and seeds on the SAME validation split, so their p-values are exploratory. This manifest freezes the main comparisons, endpoints, seed count and statistics BEFORE any WikiText-103 test-split evaluation, and the confirmation data (wiki.test.raw) has never been read by any earlier phase. v2 (review-2 revision): the seed count was raised 6 -> 12 and the manifest gained a machine-checkable binding block and a scope declaration; the revision was made strictly BEFORE any test-split evaluation (no P5T result has ever existed -- no results_lm_test/ record, no commit touching the test split), which is the only condition under which a pre-registration may be revised without selection bias.
training_recipe: P3MT/P4MT/P5C: 3000 steps, seq 512, batch 12 (18.4M tokens consumed per run over the 8M-token train cache; identical data order per seed), all four arms under one config; csa_fixed_rope & full_rope via P3MT/P4MT (seeds 0-5) + P5C (seeds 6-11), controls via P3MTC/P5C (seeds 0-11, same recipe and outdir).

binding.training_recipe_note: Machine-checkable subset of the run_cfg fingerprint (keys as decoded by exp_lib.run_cfg_knobs). mt/mr/det/df/cs are deliberately NOT pinned: they bind variant/environment/data/code and are verified separately (_code stamp, data_fp, manifest sha). Any record whose recipe fails this signature is refused by the confirmation statistics entry.

training_data_fingerprint.fingerprint_rule: exp_lib._ids_fp over the served 1-D train ids (train_fp on every checkpoint and training record)
training_data_fingerprint.binding_rule: if canonical_train_fp is a non-null string, every checkpoint and every admissible record must match it; otherwise all frozen checkpoints/records must agree on ONE non-null train_fp, which the first P5T access writes into results_lm_test/.freeze_lock.json and every later run must match. Mixed or missing train_fp is a hard refusal.
training_data_fingerprint.note: The literal value is intentionally not guessed here: it becomes checkable only against a built wt103_cache. Until then the run derives it from the frozen checkpoints BEFORE the first test read and locks it; a later change of training corpus is rejected.

test_slice.fingerprint_rule: exp_lib._ids_fp over the flattened (n_seqs, seq_len) rows; every record must carry the same non-null data_fp; the first P5T access writes it into results_lm_test/.freeze_lock.json

tokenizer.fit: same deterministic BPE fit as load_wikitext (first <=50k TRAIN rows only, vocab 8192)
tokenizer.check: load_wikitest hard-compares the full id->token vocabulary against any cached train tokenizer and refuses on mismatch

checkpoint.stamp: v11.125 (= exp_lib.CODE_SEMANTICS; records carry _code, ckpt carries code)
checkpoint.hash: sha256 of the .pt file, stored per record as ckpt_sha256 at P5T evaluation time

eval.data: wiki.test.raw via exp_lib.load_wikitest (held out; the ONLY phase allowed to read it)
eval.per_document: bylen records additionally store ppl_per_seq (per-row PPL) so document-sampling uncertainty can be stratified; n_seqs=16 does NOT cover the language-population distribution and population-level claims are out of scope (design_notes section 20)

scope.confirmatory_claims: ONLY fixed-chunk CSA mechanism claims: learned top-k selection vs trained controls, sparse length extrapolation vs full RoPE attention, and block-compression/KV-projection effects at the frozen endpoints.
scope.not_covered: dynamic chunking vs fixed chunking, semantic value of dynamic boundaries, HCA advantages, and dynamic-chunking scaling laws are NOT covered by this confirmation (no dynamic arm, no HCA comparison is frozen here).
scope.required_for: those claims require their own pre-registered freeze (arms, seeds, endpoints) before their first test-split access; until then they stay exploratory regardless of how the fixed-chunk confirmation turns out.

primary_comparisons.name: main: csa_fixed_rope - full_rope @ L4096 (test)
primary_comparisons.hypothesis_direction: csa_fixed_rope better (negative delta) would confirm the sparse length-extrapolation advantage seen on validation

primary_comparisons.name: control: csa_fixed_rope_randidx - csa_fixed_rope @ L4096 (test)
primary_comparisons.hypothesis_direction: positive delta would confirm that learned selection beats a TRAINED random selector at equal budget (the test-time intervention cannot answer this)

primary_comparisons.name: control: csa_fixed_rope_allblocks - csa_fixed_rope @ L4096 (test)
primary_comparisons.hypothesis_direction: positive delta would confirm that learned top-32 selection beats TRAINED all-block reading at equal budget

primary_comparisons.name: aligned-dense: full_rope - csa_fixed_rope_allblocks @ L4096 (test)
primary_comparisons.hypothesis_direction: isolates block-compression/KV-projection from selection: same-projection dense-style reading vs standard dense attention (non-directional mechanism readout)

statistics.test: exact two-sided sign-flip over paired per-seed deltas
statistics.power_note: q = probability that a single seed's paired delta falls in the pre-registered direction. Power is computed for the FIRST Holm gate (the hardest). 12 seeds was chosen so the plan is not merely mathematically able to reject (>= 8 seeds) but has moderate power at optimistic q; at q=0.8 power is only ~0.28 -- mathematical possibility is NOT sufficient power, and the validation panels' sign-consistency rates are the only (exploratory) source for calibrating q. exp_lib.signflip_power recomputes this table deterministically.
statistics.validity_assumptions: the exact sign-flip p requires within-seed exchangeability: both arms of a pair share everything stochastic except the arm itself (identical per-seed data order over the shared cache, same eval rows, same corruption grid; init RNG is seeded per seed -- architecture-induced RNG consumption differences are part of the arm). Seed-number equality alone does not provide this; see design_notes section 20.
statistics.decision_rule: A comparison is CONFIRMED only if p_holm < 0.05 AND its direction matches the validation-panel estimate; otherwise the claim stays exploratory. Probe/delta-NLL/NIAH results on the test split are reported descriptively (secondary) and carry no significance claims.
statistics.seed_policy: seeds 0-11 fixed above; no seeds may be added after the first test-split evaluation (adding seeds after seeing results is selection bias by construction). Missing seeds at run time are reported as-is (smaller honest n), never topped up. The load-time power gate refuses any future manifest whose min attainable Holm p exceeds alpha.

history.change: initial freeze: 6 seeds, two-sided exact sign-flip, Holm/4, p_floor 0.03125
history.defect: min attainable Holm p = 4 x 2/2^6 = 0.125 > 0.05 -- confirmation probability identically zero by construction (review-2 issue 1); flagged at analysis time only, as a 'conservative' warning

history.change: seeds 6 -> 12 (min attainable Holm p 0.125 -> 0.00195; power table recorded); added machine-checkable binding block (training_recipe_signature, test-slice rule, tokenizer fit, checkpoint stamp/hash); added scope declaration (fixed-chunk claims only); P5C now trains all four frozen arms at manifest seeds; strict record admission + freeze-lock enforced in v12_supp.py
history.precondition_verified: no test-split evaluation had occurred at revision time: results_lm_test/ has never existed on any machine, no P5T/phase commit exists in git history, and load_wikitest had never been called by any driver

revision.rule: any further revision requires either (a) proof that no test-split access has occurred (git history + absent lock + absent bylen records), or (b) V12_REFREEZE=1 after access, which permanently downgrades the earlier round to exploratory in the plan history above

history_note: v1 frozen 2026-10-16 in the commit that introduced v12_supp.py; v2 revised 2026-10-17 in the review-2 revision commit (see the plan history above). The test split has never been read by the codebase before (earlier documentation covered only train/valid).
